motions.motion: Councilmember Wright moved to approve the Consent Agenda, removing items 12.C. and 12.D. from the agenda and placing them after Item 13.A. on the regular agenda. Councilmember Rich Wood seconded the motion.

motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving the Enyo Development Agreement
motions.motion: Councilmember Wright moved to adopt an Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving the Enyo Development Agreement as presented in the agenda packet. Councilmember Wood seconded the motion.

motions.item_title: A Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Adopting the Downtown Plan
motions.motion: Councilmember Burnham moved to adopt the Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah Adopting the Downtown Master Plan. Councilmember Wright seconded the motion.

motions.item_title: A Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Supporting the Creation of a Utah Inland Port Authority Project Area in Eagle Mountain City
motions.motion: Councilmember Clark moved to table the Resolution, Supporting the Creation of a Utah Inland Port Authority Project Area in Eagle Mountain City, for further discussion. Councilmember Rich Wood seconded the motion.
